The main takeaway from our work is that
the processor bounds for the problems of maximum weight matching and maximums-t flow are the same.
the processor bound for the perfect matching problem in RNC is not a fundamental limitation for the design of parallel algorithms in RNC.
the parallel complexity of many combinatorial optimization problems is not determined by the processor bound, but by the problem itself.
